scope: Focused final acceptance of the actual dated public snapshot and its current display contract; no live API calls or application-source edits.

Bounded manifest parses and counts match declared selected-city coverage

All retained cards satisfy the final conservative provider filter and unverified category contract
The final nine concrete specialty, diagnostic, blood-donation and administrative findings are absent

checks.name: Public JSON has only the expected geographic schema and no credential fields or authenticated provider URL

details.method: Schema whitelist, credential markers and URL inspection; no live credential was read

limitations: No live gateway deployment or provider API was exercised in this review.
The snapshot covers selected cities and can become stale; public map categories do not verify emergency service, opening hours, capacity, nearest distance to a person, or clinical suitability.
Credential inspection checks public schema and output markers; the actual private API key was neither accessed nor logged.
Final browser layout and deployed-asset checks are tracked by the release suites.
